context_requirements: Expression of the drug's direct targets (PRKAB1/ACACB) or related metabolic machinery
Intact insulin/AMPK signaling for downstream metabolic gene regulation
Hepatocyte-like metabolic context for robust transcriptional response (e.g., HEPG2)
falsifiers: No consistent directional change in any of the listed proximal or late genes across cell lines at 6 h or 24 h
Strong upregulation of cholesterol biosynthesis genes (e.g., HMGCR, HMGCS1) rather than downregulation
Clear and strong transcriptional response in all nine cell lines with magnitude 'strong' at 6 h, contradicting the expected weak/slow kinetics
